fusions.name: Snatched Morsel
fusions.desc: A darting bite that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Upset the Table
fusions.desc: Overturns the table, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles. You regain 8 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Buried Larder
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you, with a 10% chance to heal critically. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Henhouse Frenzy
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
